defs.def: important in history; likely to be thought of as important at some time in the future 历史上著名（或重要）的；可名垂青史的

ex.s: The house is now listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
ex.t: 这座房子如今已被列入《国家史迹名录》。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.

ex.t: 他们还希望进一步教育人们保护历史和文化遗产的重要性，以便子孙后代理解和欣赏。
